Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One +, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert.
Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen.
Deine Aufgaben
Analyse und Optimierung von Prozessen im lower Funnel und Identifikation von Cross-Selling Potenzialen (Wärmepumpe)
Erstellung, Tracking und Interpretation relevanter Funnel, Performance und Wachstums KPIs
Identifikation von Prozessineffizienzen, auch mithilfe von AI, sowie Unterstützung bei der Ableitung und Umsetzung von Verbesserungsmaßnahmen
Mitarbeit bei der Entwicklung, Umsetzung und Auswertung von Maßnahmen zur Reaktivierung verlorener Leads
Enge Betreuung/Enablement des Tagesgeschäft im Sales, sowie enge Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing, Operations und Product zur Umsetzung datengetriebener Optimierungen
Dein Profil
Erste relevante Berufserfahrung (1-2 Jahre) im Management Consulting, Venture Building, Startup Umfeld oder in einem anderen skalierungsorientierten, schnellebigen Umfeld (Growth Operations/Business Development-Rolle)
Hohe Eigeninitiative, ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität und die Motivation, neue Themen eigenverantwortlich von der ersten Idee bis zur Umsetzung voranzutreiben
Du arbeitest strukturiert und datenorientiert, kannst komplexe Zusammenhänge schnell erfassen und daraus pragmatische Handlungsempfehlungen ableiten
Erfahrung mit AI-Tools, digitalen Produkten oder AI-getriebenen Geschäftsmodellen ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung
Fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️
Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen
Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit.
Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten.
Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt.
Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt.
Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt.
Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents.
Dein Extra-Boost - 29 + 2 Urlaubstage, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden.
Wir bei Enpal sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Nationalität, Geschlechteridentität, sexuelle Orientierung, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen. Enpal steht für einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz und geht gegen Diskriminierung und Belästigung jeglicher Art vor.

## About Our Client ##
Our client is a well-established international membership-based organization headquartered in Zurich. Operating in a highly professional and collaborative environment, the organization supports a global network of stakeholders and relies on strong operational and financial processes to deliver its mission effectively. The team is seeking a hands-on finance and operations professional who enjoys balancing accounting responsibilities with wider business support activities
## Job Description ##
Financial Administration & Accounting
* Oversee daily accounting transactions across payables, receivables, and ledger activities.
* Review and process supplier invoices, employee expenses, and payment instructions.
* Perform account reconciliations and investigate discrepancies where required.
* Contribute to monthly and annual closing activities.
* Maintain accurate and well-organized financial records and supporting documentation.
Reporting, Budgeting & Compliance
* Assist in the preparation of annual budgets, forecasts, and financial planning activities.
* Produce financial reporting packages and management summaries.
* Monitor budget performance and highlight key variances.
* Support external audits and coordinate with accounting, tax, and advisory partners.
* Help ensure compliance with relevant accounting standards, VAT obligations, and regulatory requirements.
Business Operations & Administration
* Coordinate administrative activities supporting the smooth running of the office.
* Manage supplier relationships, service agreements, and procurement-related activities.
* Support employee administration, payroll coordination, and documentation processes.
* Maintain operational procedures, templates, and internal systems.
* Assist with the planning and coordination of meetings and governance activities.
Contracts, Governance & Process Improvement
* Maintain contract files and monitor agreement renewals and obligations.
* Support internal compliance initiatives and governance requirements.
* Coordinate insurance, statutory documentation, and corporate records.
* Contribute to strengthening internal controls and operational best practices.
* Identify opportunities to improve workflows, automate routine tasks, and enhance efficiency.
Data Management & Business Support
* Ensure data quality across finance and operational platforms.
* Develop reports and insights to support decision-making.
* Participate in systems enhancements and implementation projects.
* Provide general support on operational initiatives and continuous improvement activities.
## The Successful Applicant ##
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Fluent English, both written and spoken.
* German language skills would be considered a plus.
* Previous experience in accounting, finance operations, bookkeeping, or business administration.
* Solid understanding of financial processes, reporting principles, and reconciliations.
* Familiarity with budgeting, forecasting, and audit support activities.
* Knowledge of Swiss accounting and VAT requirements would be advantageous.
* Experience using accounting, ERP, and reporting systems.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and strong analytical capabilities.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Excellent organizational and prioritization abilities.
* Proactive and solution-driven mindset.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with diverse stakeholders.
* High level of discretion and professionalism when handling confidential information.
* Customer-focused approach with strong interpersonal skills
## What's on Offer ##
* Diverse position with exposure to both finance and operations.
* International working environment with broad stakeholder interaction.
* Opportunity to contribute to process improvements and organizational development.
* Collaborative team culture with close interaction across functions.

Johnson & Johnson is hiring for a Senior Sales Operations Analyst – Shockwave Medica l to join our team. The position is FULLY REMOTE and can sit anywhere in the US .
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal.

Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/.
Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments. Ready to join a team that’s pioneering the development and commercialization of Intravascular Lithotripsy (IVL) to treat complex calcified cardiovascular disease.

Our Shockwave Medical portfolio aims to establish a new standard of care for medical device treatment of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease through its differentiated and proprietary local delivery of sonic pressure waves for the treatment of calcified plaque.
Shockwave Medical is looking for a Senior Sales Operations Analyst to join its world class team. This role is responsible for analyzing complex data, generating both conclusions and recommendations, and effectively communicating those to decision-makers.

The current environment is best suited for someone with a passion for improving existing processes and who has the ability to juggle multiple priorities in a fast-paced growing organization. In this role, you’ll be working with commercial leaders to drive data-based decisions and implement solutions to improve commercial performance.

Analysis & Reporting
Interpret, self-direct, and prioritize execution of incoming requests for analysis projects.
Conduct analyses, develop conclusions & communicate recommendations to Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Finance.
Create, monitor, support and oversee reports and dashboards in Excel, Salesforce, and PowerBI.
Work with large data sets, glean intelligence from data, draw conclusions, and enabling recommendations to key stakeholder groups.
Core Processes & Project Support
Own key commercial operations initiatives including compensation, quota, business planning, reporting, territory design and other projects.
Exhibit advanced broad experience to develop and resolve complex models and procedures.
Partner with different stakeholders to build and streamline commercial operations processes.
Support sales, finance, and commercial operations teams by collecting and organizing data to inform and drive decisions.
Identify needs, develop and implement standardized tools, methodologies, and processes aimed at improving operational efficiency.
Provide mentorship to other analysts on specific projects

Bachelor’s degree in business/technical field or demonstrated relevant experience. MBA is a plus.
10+ years’ experience in Sales Operations, Finance, or other analytical function.
Ability to efficiently read in data, analyze, and present data using Python, R, or SQL a plus. Experience in medical device or other life sciences industry is preferred.
Utilizes education and work experience to become subject matter expert in areas of expertise and within tasks.
Self-motivated and able to prioritize work effectively and independently.
Ability to efficiently and effectively handle multiple and shifting priorities.
Highly organized with strong time management skills.
Strong attention to detail.
Able to generate conclusions from analyses to drive decisions and able to communicate those to diverse audiences both verbally and in writing.
Able to understand and clarify ambiguous stakeholder requests.
Able to solve complex problems with strong intellectual curiosity.

This is a 100% remote role in Europe* About Us : Zeitview is the leading intelligent aerial imaging company for high-value infrastructure, providing businesses with actionable, real-time insights to recover revenue, reduce risk and improve build quality.

We serve customers in the solar, wind, insurance, construction, real estate, and critical infrastructure industries. Trusted by the largest enterprises in the world, Zeitview is active in over 70 countries. Our mission is to accelerate the global transition to renewable energy and sustainable infrastructure through advanced inspection solutions.

Take a look at our latest achievements here! About the Role : In the role of Operations Coordinator, you'll be the go-to person for making sure our wind inspections run smoothly. It's a chance to be right at the heart of what we do, ensuring that our projects not only meet but exceed the high standards our clients expect from us. Responsibilities :
Plan and coordinate wind operations with a focus on professionalism and efficiency, making sure our pilots and customers always have a great experience with Zeitview .
Take the lead in recruiting and training new pilots, helping them through our online training program and setting them up for success.
Make sure everything's ready for our pilots before they arrive on site, ensuring we deliver our projects on time.
Tackle any issues that come up on the fly, and make sure our clients receive the highest standard of quality and service.
Be there to support our pilots with any site access or planning needs they have, and help iron out any project issues.
Possess an understanding of drone capabilities and airspace regulations while adhering to Zeitview SOPs.
Maintain a pulse on the wind industry.
Occasionally work side by side with our Quality Control team to make sure our work maintains the golden standard.
Juggle multiple projects, keeping in touch with pilots in the field, and staying on top of their day-to-day challenges.
Keep track of everything with daily reports and updates, using a mix of spreadsheets and software.

Project management skills and attention to detail.
Comfortable using tools such as Google Suite (Sheets and Docs), Slack, Coda and Asana.
Familiarity with the wind industry, including specific equipment and access requirements is a nice-to-have.
Ability to work independently and in a team.
Excellent communication and writing skills in English and ideally also Turkish); ability to communicate with customers, pilots, and internal teams.

Feel great about your work as you join a leading mission-driven intelligent aerial imaging company - our goal is to accelerate the global transition to renewable energy and sustainable infrastructure, and you personally will play a large part in making this happen!

ISTA Personnel Solutions South Africa is a dynamic, fast-growing BPO company providing operational support to U.S.-based healthcare companies. We are not a recruitment agency — we act as a dedicated extension of our clients' teams, delivering high-quality service with precision and professionalism.

We are seeking an empathetic, organised, and proactive Client Care & Operations Coordinator to support a growing U.S.-based ABA therapy provider. This is a communication-focused role where you'll help ensure both families and employees receive an exceptional experience while providing valuable operational and administrative support to leadership.

This position combines client care, quality oversight, operational coordination, and administration. You'll serve as a key point of contact for families, assist with employee check-ins, monitor service quality, support compliance activities, and contribute to projects that improve the overall efficiency of the Care Coordination team.

We're looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership, proactively solving problems, and creating exceptional experiences for both families and employees. PLEASE NOTE:

Working Hours: Monday – Friday, 4:00 PM – 1:00 PM SAST (subject to daylight saving time).

Public Holidays: This role requires working on both South African and U.S. public holidays (compensation for SA public holidays in accordance with the BCEA).

Internet Requirements: A fixed fibre line with a minimum speed of 25 Mbps upload and download with wired Ethernet capability is mandatory. Applicants without fixed fibre cannot be considered.

Power Backup: Reliable backup power is required to manage load shedding or outages. Applicants without backup power cannot be considered.

Work Environment: Fully remote.

Training: Comprehensive training will be provided, with responsibilities introduced progressively as you become familiar with the role.

Conduct welcome calls with new families and introduce yourself as their primary operational point of contact.
Explain the onboarding process, attendance expectations, and answer non-clinical questions.
Complete scheduled family satisfaction check-ins.
Identify concerns early and escalate where appropriate.
Request Google reviews from satisfied families.
Coordinate family exit interviews and gather valuable feedback.
Employee Experience
Conduct onboarding check-ins with newly hired staff.
Conduct regular wellbeing and retention check-ins with clinical employees.
Identify potential concerns relating to engagement, support, or burnout.
Escalate concerns to leadership when required.
Quality & Compliance
Monitor attendance and cancellation trends.
Review case health and family engagement.
Assist with tracking authorisations, assessments, and required documentation.
Assist with monitoring employee onboarding, compliance documentation, certifications, and required training milestones.
Prepare reports highlighting trends, successes, and opportunities for improvement.
Support ongoing quality improvement initiatives.
Operational Support
Assist leadership with operational and administrative tasks.
Communicate with insurance companies, outside agencies, and healthcare partners.
Follow up on outstanding documentation.
Assist with operational projects and process improvements.
Provide general administrative support as required.

Previous experience in customer service, healthcare administration, client care, operations, administration, quality assurance, or care coordination.
Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
Professional, confident, and compassionate telephone manner.
High emotional intelligence with the ability to navigate sensitive conversations professionally.
Strong organisational and time management skills.

About SafeLease
At SafeLease , we're rethinking how P&C insurance is sold in an age of technological change. We believe the industry's biggest inefficiencies aren't technical problems — they're structural ones. And we're building the team to tackle them.

SafeLease is a profitable insurance business that designs, underwrites, and distributes specialty coverage for commercial property owners and their tenants. Most insurance companies either distribute products or bear the risk — we do both.

We back our policies with our own capital, which means we control the full stack: product design, tech, and the speed at which we move. That end-to-end ownership lets us offer customers real flexibility, saving time and money for more than 4,000 properties insured for billions in value nationwide.

We're a team of 70, growing over 100% annually, and we've done it without sacrificing profitability or culture. Here, you'll get high discretion and a wide aperture of problems to solve. We embrace the newest technologies, move fast together, and operate with the intensity of a small company where every person's work is visible.

If you're looking for a place to sharpen your craft alongside people who take their work seriously, you'll fit right in. About the role We're growing fast, launching new products, and running marketing across multiple brands and verticals at once, powered by a connected stack including HubSpot and Salesforce.

That means a lot of moving pieces: platforms that need to talk to each other, launches that need clear requirements before they kick off, and projects that need someone keeping an eye on the whole picture. This role is that person.

You'll make sure nothing falls through the cracks, turn messy requirements into clear specs, and look at our data to tell us what's actually working. If you like being the person who connects the dots across a growing company, this is a great seat to be in. What you'll do: Keep our systems connected
Keep HubSpot and Salesforce connected and working together (CRM, email/campaign tools, website, and others)

s.h: Build reporting that shows the team what's converting and why
s.t:
Shape how launches happen
Gather and document requirements from stakeholders ahead of any launch, campaign, or project, so teams start with clarity instead of guesswork
Translate marketing's needs into clear specs when something needs to be built by engineering or another team
Dig into current processes and performance data to find what's working and where we can do better

Track all active marketing projects and launches, keep timelines visible, and catch blockers before they become deadline problems
Be the person the team trusts to know where everything stands, without anyone having to ask
Be the go-to point of contact when marketing needs a technical build, and see it through to delivery

2-4 years of experience in business analysis, marketing operations, or a related role
Required: hands-on experience with HubSpot and Salesforce
A fast learner who picks up new platforms quickly and figures out how they connect to everything else

A knack for spotting problems in data or process and explaining them clearly to anyone, technical or not
The kind of organized that keeps multiple projects moving without anything slipping
Comfortable using AI tools (like Claude) to work faster and smarter
Why SafeLease ? The tech: Our prospects convert fast because we’re solving real problems and delivering serious value to commercial real estate owners. The team: We’re a team of seasoned pros and sharp operators who know how to move fast and build smart. High standards, low ego.

The stability: We’re well-funded, growing fast, and we make sure our team shares in that success with competitive pay and equity. The employee experience: We also offer unlimited PTO, full health benefits, flexible work setups, and the kind of culture where people want to show up to do their best work.

If you don't have all the qualifications listed, don't worry! We understand everyone's career path is unique and still encourage you to apply if you feel this role is aligned with your career trajectory. Employment at SafeLease is contingent upon a satisfactory verification of a general and criminal background check. Originally posted on Himalayas

Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.
We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.

At Careem, we are revolutionizing the way customers access everyday essentials. Our Shops team is dedicated to providing seamless delivery experiences from supermarkets, florists, pharmacies, and more through our marketplace. We work closely with our partners to ensure they are equipped with the tools and support needed to succeed. As an Ops Coordinator, you will play a crucial role in ensuring operational efficiency, partner satisfaction, and a top-tier customer experience.

Support Operational Performance: Assist in monitoring key operational metrics such as order fulfilment, stock availability, and merchant response times to ensure a smooth experience for customers and partners.
Partner Assistance & Relationship Management: Act as a key point of contact for merchants, providing guidance on processes, addressing their concerns, and ensuring they have the necessary support.
Inventory & Assortment Oversight: Help maintain accurate item listings and stock availability to reduce out-of-stock issues and enhance customer satisfaction.
Promotions & Campaign Coordination: Support merchants in implementing promotions and discounts on time to maximize sales opportunities.
Quality & Accuracy Maintenance: Ensure that partner catalogs are kept up to date with correct product details, pricing, and availability.
Merchant Support: Guide Merchants through the use of Careem’s internal tools and systems to improve their order management and operational efficiency.
Order Flow Improvement: Work with partners to identify potential delays and suggest improvements to streamline their processes.
Team Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams, including logistics, commercial, and customer support, to ensure smooth day-to-day operations and resolve challenges effectively.
What You'll Need
Analytical Mindset: Ability to read and interpret data, draw insights, and make data-driven decisions to improve performance.
Customer & Partner Focus: Strong relationship management skills with a partner-first approach to resolving issues.
Technical Proficiency: Comfortable working with internal dashboards, Excel/Google Sheets, and CRM tools. SQL knowledge is a plus.
Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to identify pain points in vendor operations and implement actionable solutions.
Excellent Communication: Ability to interact with vendors professionally and guide them through operational processes.
Agility & Adaptability: Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple tasks, and adapt to changing business needs.

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

## Your Purpose ##
The Regional Security Operational Manager - Private Destinations is responsible for leading the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of security operations across the company's designated private destinations. The role focuses primarily on operational development projects, security infrastructure planning, risk management programs, and the establishment of security standards that support the safe and secure operation of private destination assets.
Acting as a regional representative of the Global Security Department, the Regional Security Operational Manager provides strategic guidance and operational oversight for all security-related initiatives associated with private destinations, ensuring the protection of guests, crew members, employees, contractors, facilities, and company assets.
The position serves as the primary liaison between private destination operations and the Global Security Department, ensuring the consistent implementation of corporate security policies, procedures, standards, and risk management practices across all assigned locations. The role is responsible for driving security project development, enhancing operational readiness, and supporting the delivery of long-term security objectives for private destinations.
In addition to its primary focus on private destination security operations and development projects, the position will provide operational support to Fleet Security activities when required by the Global Security Department, ensuring alignment with broader corporate security strategies and operational priorities.

*Private Destination Security (Ocean Cay & Sandy Cay):*
* Act as the regional representative of the Global Security Department for the USA, Caribbean, and private destinations.
* Provide timely security advice and support to regional leadership, vessel management teams, and business stakeholders.
* Maintain awareness of regional threats, geopolitical developments, criminal activity, and operational risks that may impact business operations.
* Act as the regional security lead during crisis, incident response, and business continuity events, coordinating with Global Security,
* Oversee all daily security operations at Ocean Cay and Sandy Cay private destinations.
* Oversee regional security service providers and contracted security personnel.
* Ensure that the Global standard procedures are implemented to safeguard guests, staff, facilities, infrastructure, and company assets.
* Promote a strong security culture and compliance with company security expectations.
* Conduct regular security assessments and Internal audits of private destination operations.
* Oversee security team development, recruitment, performance management, training programmes, and certification requirements.
* Develop and deliver security awareness and compliance training for security personnel and island-based staff.
* Coordinate emergency preparedness, drills and crisis management activities.
* Oversee security systems including CCTV, access control, alarms, perimeter protection, and monitoring solutions.
* On behalf of Global Security, oversee and support security projects and technology enhancements.
* Produce executive monthly reports of incidents, lessons learned, and recommendations for continuous improvement.
* Support the Regional Security investigator when required to investigate security incidents at private destinations.
* Build and maintain effective relationships with the relevant Maritime Authorities.
*Fleet Security Oversight (when required):*
* Oversee security operations for vessels trading within U.S. and Caribbean waters and ports.
* Guide compliance with applicable maritime security regulations and company standards.
* Support vessel security assessments, audits, inspections, and security reviews.
* Produce executive reports, lessons learned, and recommendations for continuous improvement.
* When required, oversee all security operations at MSC Cruise Terminal AA and other Terminals within the USA (when the MSC Vessel is alongside)

* Fluent in English (written and spoken).
* Full understanding and practical application of the International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code.
* Previous experience as a Chief Security Officer aboard a major international cruise line is highly desirable and considered a significant advantage.
* Experience working with law enforcement, government agencies, port authorities, and international security stakeholders is highly desirable.
* Certified Port Facility Security Officer (PFSO) and Ship Security Officer (SSO).
* Minimum of 8-10 years' experience in corporate security, maritime security, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience managing security operations within the maritime, cruise, or transportation industries.
* Thorough knowledge of cruise industry operations and awareness of comparable security practices across competing organizations.
* Strong understanding of maritime security frameworks, regulations, and industry best practices.
* Above-average ability to manage crises, resolve problems, and handle sensitive situations with tact, diplomacy, and professionalism.
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, written communication, and negotiation skills.
* Proven ability to build and maintain productive working relationships within a diverse and collaborative team environment.
* High level of integrity, discretion, sound judgment, and professionalism.
* Ability to develop, review, and maintain security procedures, reports, policies, and operational manuals.
* Proven capability to assess risks, investigate incidents, and implement effective mitigation measures.
* Must have the legal right to live and work in the United States.

* Willingness to undertake regular visits to vessels, ports, terminals, and private destinations.

Reporting to the Sr. Director of GTM Operations, APAC, you’ll be the go-to operations partner for the Regional VP of Sales for ANZ, helping shape and deliver the sales strategy in the region.

· Act as the operational right hand to the RVP, collaborating on forecasting, performance analysis, GTM planning, pipeline management, and regional execution.

· Collaborate globally with peers in GTM Ops, Enablement, and RevOps to influence process, tooling, and KPI standards.

· Contribute to global initiatives where appropriate, ensuring the voice of ANZ is represented in broader field operations strategy.

Expertise in CRM and sales tools, especially Salesforce, and a working understanding of pipeline hygiene, forecasting methodologies, and territory management.
Experience guiding and coaching remote analysts or offshore resources to support core business functions, ensuring alignment, clarity, and impact.
A growth mindset, you embrace change, seek feedback, and aren’t afraid to roll up your sleeves and drive results.
A team-first orientation, you’ll be part of a globally distributed, collaborative ops community that thrives on shared success.

We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles.

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

A "certification" letter should be on letterhead of the appropriate military branch of the service and contain (1) the military service dates including the expected discharge or release date; and (2) the character of service.

We are building a new proprietary crypto trading desk and need a Trade Operations Manager to run its day-to-day operations. This is a hands-on role. You will own the operational plumbing of the desk, ensuring every part of the trade lifecycle runs smoothly, accurately and at scale.
You'll sit close to the trading and engineering teams and report directly to the Head of Trading. Your job is to keep the trade lifecycle running with speed and precision, respond fast when something breaks, and turn a startup setup into operations that scale as our capital under management grows to multiple million euros.
This is ideal for someone who likes owning the details, wants real responsibility early and would rather fix the process than write a memo about it. It's an operator role, not a strategy or business-management role. If you want to run the machine day to day and see the impact of your work immediately, this is for you.
Tasks
What you would do
Trade Operations (your core)
Run the full trade lifecycle day to day: order execution monitoring, reconciliation, and reporting.
Own daily reconciliation across venues, custodians, and wallets. Keep it clean and keep it current.
Monitor execution in real time. Spot bad fills, routing problems, stale quotes, and slippage, and get them fixed fast.
Build and maintain the operational tools and workflows that keep trading activity running smoothly.
Incident Response & Reliability
Own the incident runbook. When something breaks (a trading error, a venue outage etc.) you are first responder and you drive it to resolution.
Track incidents, find root causes, and close the loop with the engineering team so the same thing doesn't happen twice.
Keep the desk resilient: monitoring, alerting, and clear escalation paths.
Process & Reporting
Improve operational processes continuously to cut errors, reduce manual work, and free traders from operational bottlenecks.
Produce clean operational reporting and KPI tracking for the Head of Trading.
Support coordination with exchanges, custodians, and other external operational partners.
Risk & Compliance (support)
Monitor risk exposures and trading limits day to day, and flag breaches immediately.
Operate the controls and reporting the desk relies on, and support the wider risk and compliance framework owned above you.

Experience in trading operations, trade support, middle/back office, or a related operational function in digital assets or traditional finance. A proprietary trading, hedge fund, or exchange background is a strong plus.
Hands-on mindset. You build and fix things yourself and you're comfortable in a lean, non-hierarchical setup without direct reports.
Sharp eye for detail under time pressure. Reconciliation breaks and execution anomalies don't slip past you.
Technical fluency: comfortable with Excel and SQL, and able to read or write basic scripts to automate operational work.
Calm and fast under incidents. You keep a clear head when something breaks in production.
Strong communication and organizational skills. You can run a process and keep the people around it informed.
Keen interest in blockchain, crypto, and DeFi is a definite plus.

Own the operational backbone of a trading desk being built from the ground up.
Work at the intersection of crypto infrastructure, systematic trading, and emerging financial markets.
Join a small, high-impact team where your work has an immediate and visible impact on how the desk runs.

Flexible working arrangements
Option to work remotely within european timezones
A fun and friendly crew of blockchain enthusiasts
30 days of paid vacation
Paid leave of up to five days per year for voluntary/honorary activities

What this job can offer you
You will own and improve the platforms Customer Experience runs on: Zendesk, Vitally, and the integrations that connect them to the rest of the stack.
This is hands-on platform work with real scope. You configure, automate, integrate, and maintain systems used every day by support and customer success teams. You work with autonomy on agreed priorities, use automation (including AI-assisted workflows where they fit), and partner with operations and technical teams when a problem needs more than configuration alone.
You will see work through from scoping to production and ongoing ownership: testing changes, communicating with affected teams, documenting what you ship, and keeping platforms reliable as requirements grow.
How this role contributes to the department's and company's goals
Remote's CX organization depends on reliable tooling: routing that works, automations that hold up under load, and platforms that specialists can trust. This role keeps that foundation solid as the business and product surface area grow.
You will help CX scale without adding friction: fewer manual workarounds, clearer workflows, and platform changes that ship with proper testing, communication, and documentation. Strong platform operations also creates the conditions for automation and AI initiatives to land safely. The work sits close to the teams who use these tools every day, so the impact is direct and measurable.

Support fraud, waste, and abuse review activities by analyzing utilization patterns, claim trends, provider/pharmacy activity, and other data indicators.

Aufgaben
Deine wichtigste Aufgabe ist es, sicherzustellen, dass RoboService zur richtigen Zeit über die richtigen Roboter, Komponenten und Partner verfügt – und unsere Kundenprojekte zuverlässig umgesetzt werden können.
Du übersetzt unsere Sales-Pipeline und geplante Kundenprojekte in eine vorausschauende operative Planung und sorgst dafür, dass Ressourcen, Hardware und Partner rechtzeitig verfügbar sind.
Du koordinierst unsere Kundenprojekte von Auftrag bis Deployment und stellst sicher, dass technische Teams, Compliance, Lieferanten und Kunden auf einer gemeinsamen Zeitachse arbeiten.
Du baust enge Beziehungen zu führenden internationalen Robotik-Herstellern auf und entwickelst diese strategisch weiter.
Du überzeugst Hersteller davon, gemeinsam mit RoboService den europäischen Markt aufzubauen, und vertrittst RoboService souverän gegenüber internationalen Partnern.
Du verhandelst Preise, Lieferkonditionen und kommerzielle Rahmenbedingungen und sorgst dafür, dass Roboter, Greifer, Sensorik und andere kritische Komponenten rechtzeitig verfügbar sind.
Du steuerst Bestellungen, Liefertermine und Bestände und behältst dabei Kundenprojekte und zukünftige Bedarfe im Blick.
Du baust klare, pragmatische Prozesse für Projektplanung, Lieferantenmanagement, Inventar und Operations auf und entwickelst diese mit unserem Wachstum weiter.
Ein externer Compliance-Spezialist berichtet zunächst an dich.
Mit unserem Wachstum kannst du weitere Verantwortung übernehmen, ein eigenes Team aufbauen und operative Aufgaben zunehmend delegieren.

Unternehmerisches Denken, hohe Eigeninitiative und den Anspruch, Dinge wirklich voranzubringen
Eine pragmatische Hands-on-Mentalität: Du entwickelst nicht nur Konzepte, sondern setzt sie selbst um
Hohe Verlässlichkeit und Ownership – wenn du etwas übernimmst, können sich andere darauf verlassen
Starkes Verhandlungs- und Kommunikationsgeschick sowie ein überzeugendes Auftreten gegenüber internationalen Herstellern, Kunden und Partnern
Die Fähigkeit, strategisch vorauszudenken und gleichzeitig operative Details konsequent abzuschließen
Neugier, hohe Lernbereitschaft und den Anspruch, dich und deine Arbeit kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln

Perspektive, mit dem Wachstum von RoboService ein eigenes Team aufzubauen und zu führen

Direkter Zugang zu einigen der weltweit spannendsten Robotik-Unternehmen und deren Management-Teams
Reale Robotik-Projekte bei führenden deutschen und europäischen Industrieunternehmen
Sehr viel Verantwortung, kurze Entscheidungswege und direkter Einfluss auf zentrale Unternehmensentscheidungen
Unternehmensbeteiligung über Employee Stock Options
Arbeit an einer Technologie und einem Markt, der gerade erst entsteht – mit der Chance, ihn aktiv mitzugestalten

The Global Digital Experience team at Uber is responsible for building and scaling enterprise-grade platforms & products that power operations globally. As a Senior Product Operations Manager supporting Platform Integrity, you will own the Product Operations portfolio for a critical operational domain spanning Safety, Risk, Payments, Identity and Compliance for Uber's Community Operations team.
Platform Integrity sits at the center of trust, resilience, and operational excellence across Uber. This role will partner deeply with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, and regional Operations teams to intake product needs, translate them into clear problem statements, prioritize them alongside product leaders, and drive disciplined execution from discovery through global rollout and post-launch optimization.
A major focus of this role will be using GenAI, machine learning models, and automation to improve how Platform Integrity products are built, deployed, and scaled. You will help identify where model-enabled workflows can reduce manual effort, improve decision quality, strengthen risk detection, enhance compliance readiness, and create more consistent experiences for internal teams and external users.
This is a high-impact, highly cross-functional role for a strategic operator who can bring structure to ambiguous problem spaces, connect operational pain points to product and platform priorities, and ensure that launches are thoughtful, measurable, globally scalable, and durable across complex regulatory and business contexts.
Success in this role requires strong strategic judgment, systems thinking, analytical depth, executive communication, and the ability to influence without authority across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Operations, Legal, Compliance, Policy, and regional stakeholder groups.
What the Candidate Will Do
Own the strategic Product Operations portfolio for Platform Integrity, spanning Safety, Risk, Payments, Compliance, and related integrity workflows across Global Community Operations.
Build and manage the intake and triage mechanism for Platform Integrity product requests, ensuring requests are clearly defined, supported by data, tied to business outcomes, and evaluated against product strategy, operational urgency, risk exposure, compliance obligations, and customer impact.
Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to prioritize initiatives, sequence roadmap investments, clarify trade-offs, and align stakeholders on what should be built, why it matters, and how success will be measured.
Translate operational insights, regional feedback, model performance signals, support trends, policy changes, compliance requirements, and scalability constraints into clear product requirements, decision frameworks, and executive-ready narratives.
Co-shape the Platform Integrity AI and models roadmap by identifying, validating, and scaling opportunities for GenAI, machine learning, automation, and decision-intelligence capabilities across Safety, Risk, Payments, Identity and Compliance operations.
Partner with Data Science and Product teams to evaluate AI/model use cases, including workflow fit, human-in-the-loop design, escalation paths, quality controls, fairness considerations, operational risk, measurement plans, and post-launch monitoring needs.
Lead structured go-to-market and rollout planning for new Platform Integrity products and capabilities, including readiness planning, stakeholder engagement, documentation, training, change management, launch communications, adoption tracking, and operational support models.
Design and institutionalize scalable operating models, governance mechanisms, feedback loops, and prioritization rituals that improve how Platform Integrity product work is discovered, built, launched, and iterated.
Define and own performance measurement frameworks for launches and ongoing platform health, including adoption, accuracy, efficiency, quality, risk reduction, compliance readiness, defect reduction, and business impact metrics.
Surface post-launch insights, systemic friction points, model gaps, operational defects, and regional adoption barriers to influence roadmap evolution and continuous product improvement.
Serve as the primary Product Operations interface for senior Platform Integrity and Product stakeholders, driving alignment on business priorities, product trade-offs, resourcing decisions, launch risks, and success metrics.
Advise Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams on global feasibility, long-term maintainability, operational durability, regulatory complexity, and supportability of proposed solutions.
Elevate Product Operations standards across the organization by codifying best practices, improving product intake quality, strengthening launch discipline, and creating durable mechanisms that scale beyond individual programs.

Bachelor's degree with a strong record of academic achievement.
6+ years of experience in Product Operations, Product Strategy, Operations, Strategy & Operations, Management Consulting, Program Management, or a similarly analytical and cross-functional role.
Demonstrated experience owning complex, multi-stakeholder portfolios with significant business impact in a scaled product, platform, marketplace, risk, compliance, support, or enterprise environment.
Experience partnering with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, and Operations teams to move products from problem discovery through launch, adoption, measurement, and iteration.
Strong analytical fluency, with the ability to independently interrogate data, define measurable success metrics, identify trends, and connect product performance to operational and business outcomes.
Experience leading large-scale, global or multi-region product launches, operational transformations, or change management efforts.
Proven ability to design scalable operating models, governance frameworks, prioritization mechanisms, and feedback loops that create durable operating discipline.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated experience influencing senior stakeholders and driving executive-level alignment in ambiguous, highly matrixed environments.
Strong judgment in operational environments involving safety, risk, payments, compliance, trust, regulatory complexity, or high-volume decisioning workflows.

Experience with AI, GenAI, machine learning models, automation, decision engines, or model-enabled workflows in scaled operational or platform environments.
Familiarity with products or operations related to Safety, Risk, Payments, Compliance, Trust & Safety, Fraud, Identity, Policy, Support Operations, or regulated workflows.
Experience evaluating AI/model use cases, including workflow design, operational controls, model quality measurement, human review, escalation paths, and post-launch monitoring.
Strong business acumen, including the ability to articulate how product and platform decisions impact risk reduction, productivity, quality, compliance readiness, adoption, cost efficiency, and long-term scale.

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it.
You will own the data Vanta's EPD organization actually runs on — bringing new signal sources online, standardizing them at the point of ingestion, and building the systems that make the underlying data trustworthy rather than merely stored.
The EPD Systems team is building the infrastructure Vanta's engineering, product, and design organization depends on to understand itself. Not by asking teams to be more diligent but by going to the source, processing it, standardizing it, and pushing value back out so each source of truth earns its own adoption.

s.h: What you’ll do as a Operations Manager, Signal Systems at Vanta
s.t:
Bring new signal sources online end to end — from discovery and scoping through ingestion, standardization, and live operation
Identify the specific failure modes in each information source and build systems that mitigate them at the point of ingestion
Go to the teams that produce and consume a signal, understand what the information actually means and what they need back from it, and build accordingly
Replace human-diligence dependencies with engineering solutions: derive fields, pull from source systems, validate at write time
Build alongside teammates who are growing into building — raise their technical ceiling, not just your own output
Partner with the inference and systems layers to ensure what you produce is queryable, trustworthy, and ready to build on

s.h: How to be successful in this role
s.t:
You look at a data source and see its failure modes before its contents: where it lies, where it goes stale, where it's duplicated, where the schema won't hold at 10x

You've shipped something yourself in roughly the last 12–18 months — a pipeline, an internal tool, a working prototype, an agent — and you can walk through the code and defend your choices. Specs handed to an engineer don't count for this bar

Materialflüsse koordinieren: Du behältst den Überblick über Annahme, Klassierung, Sortierung, Lagerung und Abtransport unserer Wertstoffe und Abfälle und stellst sicher, dass Materialien zur richtigen Zeit am richtigen Ort sind.
Betrieb weiterentwickeln: Du erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale in Abläufen, Organisation und Technik und setzt diese gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung pragmatisch um.
Maschinenpark im Schuss halten: Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Bagger, Radlader, Stapler, Pressen, Schredder sowie Aufbereitungs\- und Sortieranlagen einsatzbereit, gewartet und gepflegt sind. Grössere Reparaturen sprichst du mit externen Partnern ab.
Platz \& Sicherheit: Du schaust auf Sauberkeit, Struktur und Ordnung auf dem gesamten Areal und setzt Sicherheits\-, Umwelt\- und Brandschutzregeln konsequent durch.
Verantwortung übernehmen: Du vertrittst den Geschäftsführer bei Abwesenheit und bringst deine Ideen bei Neuanschaffungen und Projekten ein.
Das bringst du mit – Führung, Technik und gesunder Menschenverstand:
Berufsausbildung: Abgeschlossene technische, handwerkliche oder vergleichbare Berufsausbildung.
Weiterbildung: Eine Weiterbildung zum Technischen , Prozessfachmann, Betriebsfachmann oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation ist von Vorteil.
Führungserfahrung: Führungserfahrung in einem operativen Umfeld mit unterschiedlich qualifizierten Mitarbeitenden ist besonders willkommen. Du kommunizierst direkt, respektvoll, klar und lässt dich auch in hektischen Momenten nicht aus der Ruhe bringen.
Hands\-on\-Mentalität: Du packst Probleme pragmatisch an, entscheidest und organisierst gerne und bist im Betrieb sichtbar und präsent.
Wohnort: Dein Wohnort ermöglicht dir eine zuverlässige Präsenz in Kaiseraugst.
Führerschein: Führerausweis Kat. B ist Pflicht; Baumaschinenausweis und/oder Maschinistenpraxis sind ein Plus.
Branchenerfahrung: Erfahrung im Recycling\-, Schüttgut\- oder Baustellenbereich ist von Vorteil – motivierte Quereinsteiger mit solider Führungspraxis sind willkommen!

Viel Freiraum: Hohe Eigenverantwortung und echtes Vertrauen in deine tägliche Arbeit.
Schlüsselposition: Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Geschäftsführer zusammen und kannst den Betrieb aktiv mitgestalten.
Abwechslungsreicher Betrieb: Unterschiedliche Materialien, Maschinen, Anlagen und Standorte sorgen dafür, dass kein Tag genau gleich aussieht.
Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Ein wirtschaftlich gesundes, regional verankertes KMU mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und langjährigen Mitarbeitenden.
Moderne Technik: Gute Maschinen und zeitgemässe Recyclinganlagen.
Klare Verantwortlichkeiten: Administration, ISO\-System, Budgetierung und Fuhrparkmanagement werden durch andere Stellen unterstützt bzw. verantwortet – du kannst dich auf die operative Führung der Betriebe konzentrieren.
Zeitgemässe Anstellungsbedingungen: 5 Wochen Ferien, gute Sozialleistungen und faire, marktgerechte Anstellungsbedingungen.
Bereit für den nächsten Schritt?
Sende uns deine Bewerbung bitte direkt. Deine Bewerbung behandeln wir selbstverständlich vertraulich. Auf die Bewerbungsadresse hat ausschliesslich der Geschäftsführer Zugriff.
(Hinweis: Wir berücksichtigen ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen. Dossiers von Personalvermittlern können wir nicht bearbeiten.)

Develop scalable processes, automation and AI-assisted workflows—including solutions using Claude Code and Cowork—to improve execution consistency and reduce coordination overhead.

Revenue Operations Manager
📍 Manchester, UK (Hybrid 2 days WFH) | 💰 Up to £70,000
Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everyone by elevating UK estate agencies through world-class technology.
Your job is to own the numbers for the entire commercial engine. Not hit them, own them. You'll build the single version of the truth that runs our marketing, sales and customer success functions, and put a reliable set of numbers in front of our leadership team and board.
You will take accountability for the integrity of the full commercial funnel from top-of-funnel marketing through to churn and renewals. Right now, each function applies its own definitions and rules. You'll set one consistent set of rules and make them stick across the entire business. You'll also be responsible for forecasting, headcount planning and supporting the design of commission structures.
This is a hands-on, senior operator role. You'll own the tech stack (HubSpot sits at the centre), and you'll build the workflows, automations and permissions that keep data clean at source. You're not tidying records by hand; you're designing systems. You'll also be working with AI daily – it's not optional here. We use Claude, and you'll need to show evidence of AI already embedded in how you work.
There are no commissions or bonuses in this role and that is deliberate. The role has to stay objective about what the figures say. We've positioned the salary to reflect both your seniority and the independence you'll need to challenge senior leaders professionally and diplomatically when the numbers don't match the narrative.

s.h: HERE'S WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT TO BE WORKING ON
s.t:
Building and maintaining complete visibility across the entire revenue line: marketing pipeline, sales pipeline, churn and renewals, and capacity planning.
Setting and enforcing a single set of definitions and rules across marketing, sales and customer success, then making them stick.
Owning HubSpot end-to-end: permissions, day-to-day usage, workflow build, automations and the processes that keep data clean at source.
Producing forecasts, headcount plans and reporting that the leadership team can actually rely on.
Contributing to the design of commission plans and commercial structures.
Supporting the hiring and onboarding of a Sales Operations person, and training them to maintain what you've built.
Presenting to the board, with numbers that are clean, consistent and defensible.
Using AI to solve problems that would otherwise drown you in manual work.
Joining up the revenue line with the wider business (think product, finance, and marketing) so everybody's working from the same playbook.

You've owned reporting across a full commercial funnel (not just the sales pipeline). You can point to a forecast you owned, a commission plan you shaped and workflows you built yourself.
HubSpot is second nature to you. You operate at expert or power-user level and you can configure permissions, automations and processes without breaking into a sweat.
You've worked in multi-product SaaS at a senior level and you understand how different product lines affect pipeline, ARR and churn.
AI is already woven into how you work. You can give concrete examples of which tools you use, what you've built with them, and how they've changed your process significantly.
You can challenge senior leaders diplomatically but firmly, and you're not afraid to report the numbers as they actually are, not as people hope they'll be.
You work best with autonomy. You're a self-starter who gets the work done yourself, not someone who needs to manage others to feel productive.
You'd rather build something new than inherit a legacy system, and you're excited by the chance to define how commercial operations should work.

You've spent your career managing the sales pipeline in isolation, without visibility into marketing and customer success.
You'd struggle with HubSpot or you'd need somebody else to handle the tech stack. This is not negotiable, unfortunately.
You need variable pay to feel motivated. Commission and bonus structures feel essential to you.
AI feels like a threat rather than a tool. You see it as something that reduces your value, not something that multiplies what you can deliver.
You need a large team beneath you from day one. This role starts solo and hands-on, though you'll build a team over time.
You'd rather build strategy than do the work. The first six months are about delivery—designing the systems, building the reports, making it stick—not sitting in planning meetings.

Experience
You've spent time in a revenue operations, commercial operations or similar role, with demonstrable ownership of the full commercial funnel. You've done the work yourself – like configuring HubSpot, building forecasts, and leading alignment conversations across functions. Multi-product SaaS experience is non-negotiable; B2B exposure is strongly preferred.
Tooling
HubSpot sits at the centre, and you're an expert here. Experience with other platforms, such as Salesforce or Pipedrive, is a plus (some skills transfer). You're comfortable across other tech stacks and you use AI regularly as part of your workflow. Other tools in the stack will change and you're flexible on that front.
Communication
You can present to senior audiences without losing clarity. You push back on senior leaders when the numbers don't match the narrative, and you do it diplomatically enough that they listen rather than push back harder. You explain complex commercial logic in plain language.
Research
You think operationally. You diagnose what's broken in a process, you ask tough questions about data quality, and you can identify which problems to tackle first based on commercial impact. You're curious about how the business actually works, not just the metrics.

Build automations, tools, and workflows (scripting, low-code, RPA, and AI or agent tooling) that eliminate manual work and let the team scale without adding headcount.

Category-defining tech. Career-defining work.
For more than a decade, Cockroach Labs has built database technology trusted to power some of the world's most mission-critical applications. Now, as AI transforms how software is created and operated, the infrastructure behind it has to keep pace. Cockroach Continuum is built to meet this moment, bringing individual databases together into one fleet designed for agentic applications, where AI agents help teams provision, scale, and optimize workloads at machine speed.
The customers you’ll work with are some of the most innovative businesses in the world, and the problems they’re trying to solve are real and urgent. You’ll bring a genuinely differentiated product to a market moving fast, at a company positioned to lead it. The people who thrive here are the ones who want to own that opportunity.

GTM Operations is a small, high-intensity team at the center of Cockroach Labs' revenue transformation. As a Strategy & Ops Manager on this team, you'll work at the intersection of data, AI, and GTM execution -- building the analytical frameworks, agentic workflows, and operational programs that reshape how we create pipeline, accelerate deals, forecast revenue, and expand customer relationships.
This role requires real technical fluency. You'll query databases, build financial models, design AI-powered workflows, and measure their impact, all in service of transforming how our revenue organization operates. If you thrive in ambiguity, move faster than the organization expects, and believe the best strategy is one that actually gets deployed, this role was built for you.
To be eligible for this role, you must be based in London and will be expected to go into our office on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays.

AI Workflow Design and Execution: Design, deploy, and iterate on agentic workflows across the revenue org -- account prioritization agents, outreach personalization, pipeline intelligence, customer health scoring. Measure real performance outcomes and use that data to improve.
GTM Analytics and Insights: Query databases, analyze go-to-market performance data, and surface insights that inform how leadership allocates resources, sets targets, and structures the revenue org. Translate complexity into clear, actionable recommendations.
Financial Modeling and Business Cases: Build the financial models that translate AI initiatives and GTM programs into measurable revenue impact including pipeline coverage, conversion rates, rep productivity, deal velocity. Make the numbers tell the story.
Territory and Capacity Planning: Own analyses that support territory design, capacity planning, and coverage model decisions using data-driven frameworks. Help ensure the sales org is structured to hit its targets.
Cross-Functional Program Execution: Drive programs end-to-end by diagnosing operational bottlenecks, designing solutions, coordinating across stakeholders, and making sure adoption sticks.
Strategic Partnership: Operate as a thought partner to senior leaders across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success. Earn influence through analytical rigor, speed of execution, and a willingness to say what the data actually shows.

2-3 years of experience at a top-tier investment bank, management consulting firm, or high-growth technology company in a strategy, operations, or analytical role
Exceptional analytical and financial modeling skills -- you can build complex models, dissect data, and translate complexity into clear recommendations
Fluency with AI tools: you use LLMs daily as a thinking partner, have experimented with prompt engineering, and are genuinely excited to push the boundaries of what AI can do in a business context
Relentless bias toward action. You don't wait for perfect information; you synthesize what's available, make a call, and iterate
Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting findings and owning outcomes with senior stakeholders
High agency and ownership mentality. You treat every project as if the outcome depends on you, because on this team, it does
The discipline to iterate on prompts, tools, and workflows rather than accepting first-pass output.
Strong judgment applied to validating, refining, or discarding AI-generated output.
An authorship standard — you direct, review, and take full accountability for everything you produce.

Experience with SQL or other querying languages
Hands-on experience building or deploying AI workflows, agents, or automations in a business context
Familiarity with GTM tools like Salesforce, Gong, Outreach, or similar
Genuine intellectual curiosity about how AI is reshaping go-to-market strategy -- you follow this space and have opinions about it

Get deep on the business -- understand how Cockroach Labs goes to market, where the bottlenecks are, and what data exists to diagnose them

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.
Flexdrive is a subsidiary of Lyft that works together with Lyft teams to realize our shared mission.
Flexdrive builds the operational backbone for the future of mobility. As a fleet management leader and Lyft subsidiary, the company extends its expertise into autonomous vehicle infrastructure — managing the physical operations that keep fleets safe, available, and performing at scale. The Nashville depot is the first proof point in a multi-market expansion.
The Opportunity
Reporting to the Operations Manager, AV Depot, the Associate Operations Manager is the second leadership layer at the Nashville AV depot. This role exists because one Operations Manager cannot provide the people leadership, floor coverage, and operational bandwidth a 24/7 depot of this scale requires.
The Associate Operations Manager carries ownership across two critical business workstreams: workforce scheduling support and process standards compliance. Fleet Operations Leads report to the Operations Manager — but during mid shifts, the Associate Operations Manager is the operational authority on the floor, directing their work, setting the quality standard, and serving as their most experienced resource and mentor.
This is a management role with a floor orientation. The Associate Operations Manager is present, coaching, directing, and executing alongside the team — while simultaneously carrying business responsibilities that directly impact depot readiness and partner compliance. This role is the bridge between the Fleet Operations Lead layer and the Operations Manager.

Scheduling & Workforce Planning Support
Owns the depot schedule — building, maintaining, and adjusting shift coverage across all teams to ensure the depot is consistently staffed and operationally ready.
Monitors attendance, manages real-time coverage gaps, and proactively addresses workforce trends before they become operational problems.
Partners with the Operations Manager on workforce planning, surfacing scheduling risks and recommendations with enough lead time to act.
Training Program Execution & Certification Compliance
Owns the planning and coordination of training program execution across all shift teams — ensuring Fleet Operations Associates and Fleet Operations Leads are scheduled, prepared, and on track to complete required partner certifications, safety refreshers, and qualification renewals.
Maintains certification and qualification records for the team, flagging upcoming renewals and escalating compliance risks to the Operations Manager before they become audit findings.
Partners with the Program Lead Trainer to ensure qualified trainers are in place, training resources are available, and delivery stays consistent across shift teams.
Floor Execution & Quality Standards
Lead the day-to-day execution of critical operational systems and processes for our 24/7 AV fleet management operations, including depot layout adherence, vehicle flow (charging, cleaning, maintenance, staging, diagnostics), parts management, and data handling.
Serves as the operational authority during mid shifts — directing Fleet Operations Leads and Fleet Operations Associates on task execution, resolving workflow conflicts, and holding the floor accountable to depot performance targets.
Owns quality on shift: vehicle readiness, safety inspections, and quality standards — inspecting, enforcing, and setting the standard by working alongside the team.
Maintains accurate shift documentation and manages shift handoffs with discipline, ensuring the incoming Fleet Operations Lead has full situational awareness and no items fall through the gap.
Fleet Operations Lead Mentorship & Operational Direction
Directs Fleet Operations Leads operationally on shift — task priorities, execution decisions, real-time escalations.
Serves as the most experienced senior leader in the building in absence of the Operations Manager, providing in-the-moment coaching and surfacing structured performance observations to the Operations Manager.

5+ years of progressive experience in operational leadership, with a strong understanding of autonomous vehicle (AV) or complex fleet operational environments.
Proven track record of launching and scaling new operational sites or programs, including accountability for facilities, team performance, and operational outcomes.

We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Operations Coordinator to own the job pipeline from intake through invoice — tracking every active job, driving progress at each stage, and making sure nothing sits without action. This role is the operational engine that keeps jobs moving, keeps the team informed, and keeps the insurance process on track.
A significant portion of this role involves direct communication with insurance companies — calling adjusters, following up on claims, tracking appraisal status, and pushing for updates that allow the team to move forward. This is not a passive role. You flag stalled jobs, escalate when needed, and take initiative to get answers without being asked. If you are organized, persistent, and comfortable on the phone with insurance representatives, this role is built for you.
How the Job Pipeline Works
Understanding the full workflow is essential to succeeding in this role:
A new job comes in — you verify it meets the intake requirements and track it in the system
You ping the sales representative to confirm the inspection date has been set
Once the inspection date is confirmed, the job moves to the next stage and a claim number is assigned
You monitor all active jobs — if a job has been sitting without progress for too long, you bring it to the Operations Manager's attention immediately
You contact the insurance company by phone and email to obtain required claim documents, following up weekly until received
Field technicians go out, take photos, and capture data — that data is entered into the platform to generate the inspection report
You use the report to write the estimate and submit it to the insurance company
Once submitted, you follow up with the insurance company on the appraisal status — calling and emailing until you have an update
You communicate appraisal updates clearly to the internal team
Once approved, the information is sent to invoicing and the job moves forward to completion

Job Intake & Pipeline Tracking
Receive and log incoming jobs, verifying they meet the required criteria before moving them into the active pipeline
Track all active jobs through each stage of the process — from intake through inspection, claim submission, appraisal, and invoice
Maintain an accurate, up-to-date job tracker so the team always knows exactly where each job stands
Proactively identify jobs that have stalled or been sitting without progress and escalate them to the Operations Manager before delays become problems
Sales Team Coordination
Ping sales representatives to confirm inspection dates have been scheduled for new incoming jobs
Follow up consistently until confirmation is received — do not wait for the information to come to you
Move jobs through the pipeline stages as milestones are hit and document each transition
Insurance Company Communication — High Volume
This is one of the most critical and time-intensive parts of the role.
Contact insurance companies by phone and email to request and obtain claim documents, adjuster assignments, and claim numbers
Follow up with insurance representatives weekly — or more frequently when deadlines are approaching — until all required documents and approvals are received
